svg.title: How Pulsar Sentinel works
svg.desc: Animated overview: 1) Pi 5 core and five agents (alaska, biloxi, gulfshores, mexico, neworleans) check in about every 20 to 30 seconds. 2) Fail closed: agent sends SENTINEL_KEY, server expects PULSAR_SERVICE_KEY, missing or mismatched key returns 401, no hardcoded default. 3) Hybrid lock: ML-KEM-768/1024 wraps the AES-256-GCM key; rotate every 90 days; retired keys may decapsulate for 7 days but cannot encapsulate. 4) ASR trail: each event writes an Agent State Record; batches build a Merkle tree sent to the chain logger. 5) PTS gauge: quantum_risk x0.4 + access_violations x0.3 + rate_limit_hits x0.2 + signature_failures x0.1; Safe under 50, Caution 50 to 149, Critical 150 and up.
svg.text: How the guard works · post-quantum security for the ShaneBrain cluster
Pi 5 core + 5 agents on the cluster radio
each agent checks in every ~20–30 s
No hardcoded default: it fails closed.
Every event writes an Agent State Record
ASR batches → Merkle root → chain logger
time-compressed loop · details below · click for the interactive walkthrough
